body:
Jank Craft Mod 1.0.3 (Forge 1.21.11, Java 21)
Jank Craft Mod is a custom content mod built and refined over many iterations.
Version 1.0.3 includes new progression items, powerful gear, custom dimensions, and unique gameplay systems like Rift generation and entity capture.

Main Features
Jank progression

Mine Jank Ore to get Raw Jank
Smelt Raw Jank into Jank
Craft advanced Jank gear and blocks
Weapons, tools, armor

Jank Sword
Jank Bow + Jank Arrow
Full Jank tools and armor set
Tuned durability and combat values
Jank Apple

Stronger than an Enchanted Golden Apple
High-tier survival/combat buffs
Epic-rarity consumable
Jank Snake system

Placeable Jank Rift Opener block with GUI
Insert Jank + enter seed to generate a random Jank-themed Rift area
Rift portals for travel
Return tool support to go back safely
Jank Painting system

Capture entities by right-clicking them with Jank Painting
Captured entities are moved to Painting Land dimension
Item name updates with a live captured-entity counter
Sneak + right-click to release captured entities near you
Technical

Forge: 61.0.8
Java: 21
Mod version: 1.0.3
Changelog Focus (1.0.3)

Added Painting Land dimension integration
Added dynamic counter display on painting item
Continued stability and feature integration fixes across systems
